name: Caura
description: Central persistent memory for OpenClaw agents — write, search, and entity lookup tools.

CAURA_AGENT_ID.description: Optional but recommended: a stable, human-readable identity for THIS install (e.g. "webclaw", "vm-01"); surfaces as the agent_id on writes. If unset, the plugin uses a stable per-install id (main-<install_id>) so installs don't collide.

MEMCLAW_AGENT_ID.$comment: legacy-name-ok: supported configuration alias for existing installs
MEMCLAW_AGENT_ID.description: Supported alias for CAURA_AGENT_ID; the new name wins when both are set.

CAURA_AUTO_WRITE_TURNS.description: Automatic capture, on by default: the plugin saves user messages, turn summaries and compaction summaries, and runs the pre-compaction flush turn, as memories private to the agent (current servers also scan them for secrets and mark them as captured). Set false (or 0, no, off) to turn all four off; explicit memory tools keep working. A value here wins over the .env file.
